LAREDO, Texas — Gabriel Adolfo Gonzalez was arrested Thursday, October 22, 2026, at 11:33 a.m., and booked into the Webb County Jail on an alleged second-degree felony charge of robbery, according to Webb County booking records.

The Webb County Sheriff's Office made the arrest, the records show. Gonzalez was booked into the county jail on the single felony charge.

No bond had been set on the charge as of the booking record reviewed by Webb Watch 956.

A second-degree felony in Texas is punishable by two to 20 years in prison and a fine of up to $10,000.

An arrest is an allegation, not a conviction. Gabriel Adolfo Gonzalez is presumed innocent unless proven guilty in a court of law.

Sources: Webb County Sheriff's Office Booking Jail Search; Webb County public-access court records.
